data.trainScope: Old RNDR 2024 Jan1-Jul16 + new RENDER Jul26-Dec31, disjoint contracts

features.2024Expert: All 2024 RNDR/RENDER contract episodes, trained before 2025
features.DeepSellingExpert: 2024 RNDR+RENDER observations with token 7d <= -10% and (BTC7<=-3% or realized 7d vol >=5)
features.ConfirmedPressureExpert: 2024 RNDR+RENDER observations with 1h sellers>=5%, 1h OI delta>=0 and 7d token return > -10%
features.winner: after penalty based on current observed regime, highest predicted net profit

warnings: Three experts trained on separate 2024 RNDR and RENDER Binance futures, 2025 and 2026 are later historical checks
Historic comparison windows have been researched before, not pristine untouched OOS
No real venue funding/latency/execution, this is H1 independent sleeve, not native common wallet
Specialist shrinkage fixed before validation and no results used to change weights
After 2024 asset migration the price/market regime may change substantially
